tutorial.first_clockin.title: Shift Started
tutorial.first_clockin.body: You're now on duty! Wait by your truck for dispatch calls. Use the dispatcher to clock out or invite a partner.
tutorial.first_incoming_call.title: Incoming Call
tutorial.first_incoming_call.body: Dispatch is sending you a service call. Press E to accept or Backspace to reject. Missed calls count as complaints.
tutorial.first_fuel_job.title: Refuelling Job
tutorial.first_fuel_job.body: Grab the jerry can from your truck, head to the stranded vehicle, and fill their tank. Watch the timer!
tutorial.first_wheel_job.title: Wheel Change
tutorial.first_wheel_job.body: Take the spare wheel and jack from your truck. Place the jack, swap the tire, then remove the jack when done.
tutorial.first_battery_job.title: Battery Replacement
tutorial.first_battery_job.body: Remove the dead battery from the vehicle, then grab a new one from your truck and install it.
tutorial.first_towing_job.title: Towing Job
tutorial.first_towing_job.body: Attach the vehicle to your tow hook and deliver it to the drop-off point marked on your map. Don't go too far from the tow vehicle!
tutorial.first_call_decline.title: Call Declined
tutorial.first_call_decline.body: Declining or missing calls adds complaints. Too many complaints will temporarily suspend you from taking shifts.
tutorial.first_cone.title: Safety Cones
tutorial.first_cone.body: Place cones around the work area for a safety bonus. You can pick them up and reposition as needed.
tutorial.first_timer_expired.title: Timer Expired
tutorial.first_timer_expired.body: You ran over time! Late finishes reduce your pay. Try to complete jobs before the timer runs out for full earnings.
tutorial.first_vehicle_damage.title: Vehicle Destroyed
tutorial.first_vehicle_damage.body: Your service vehicle was destroyed! You've been fined and received a complaint. Keep your truck safe — too many complaints leads to suspension.
tutorial.first_job_complete.title: Job Complete
tutorial.first_job_complete.body: Great work! You earned pay for that job. Complete more jobs to level up and unlock better pay multipliers.
tutorial.first_crew.title: Crew Partner
tutorial.first_crew.body: A partner joined your crew! You'll share calls and earn a co-op bonus. Both of you can work on the same job.
tutorial.first_level_up.title: Level Up!
tutorial.first_level_up.body: You've been promoted! Higher levels unlock better pay multipliers and increased tip chances.
